title: Chip's Classic Chsieled Shelves
description: A simple vanilla pack that makes the chiseled bookshelf match the style of the regular bookshelf for a more unified look.
body:
Chip’s Classic Chiseled Shelves is a small vanilla-style resource pack that unifies the look of Minecraft’s bookshelves. Instead of standing out, the chiseled bookshelf now matches the regular bookshelf, giving your builds a more consistent and polished appearance. Perfect for builders who want a clean, classic aesthetic without changing the feel of the game.

This pack is lightweight, stays true to vanilla, and can be used alongside other resource packs. Feel free to remix or include it in packs of your own — just remember to give credit :)
